requestKeyDerivation.algorithm: SHA-256 of UTF-8 compact JSON, preserving listed property order

material.prompt: The customer’s hand smoothly slides the unchanged generic identification card across the desk toward the banker. The banker keeps both hands natural and begins typing while the card remains clearly visible. Movement is restrained and realistic. Camera remains locked. Preserve the original office, desk, clothing, keyboard, monitor, card design and framing.
material.negativePrompt: Camera movement, zoom, reframing, face reveal, readable text, numbers, personal information, portrait photograph, logo, branding, card redesign, disappearing card, duplicated objects, malformed hands, extra fingers, fused fingers, warped keyboard, exaggerated movement, sudden motion, flicker, morphing.

request.inputTransportProposal: Pass the exact approved PNG as a data URI in the required image_url field so the single inference submission contains the only image input and does not require a separate storage-upload submission.

parameters.sourceDurationTargetBasis: 150 requested frames, targeting five seconds if the returned video is 30 fps; the official schema does not accept an fps or duration parameter, so this target is not guaranteed.
parameters.prompt_expansion: No separate expansion setting is documented for this endpoint; none is requested or assumed.

timing.narration: customer would come in to open a checking account simple enough
timing.allocationRule: Math.round(durationSec * 30), matching the shared V3 renderer per-shot frame allocation

fitPolicy.requestedSource: 150 model frames with a five-second source-duration target
fitPolicy.normalization: After output inspection and approval, decode and normalize locally to constant 30 fps using the verified renderer toolchain.
fitPolicy.longerThanTarget: Trim deterministically to the first 110 frames.
fitPolicy.shorterThanTarget: Hold the final decoded frame until exactly 110 frames only if it is valid video and the hold is visually acceptable; otherwise fail closed.
fitPolicy.zeroOrInvalidFrames: Reject; no synthetic replacement or retry.
fitPolicy.roundingDisclosure: 110 frames at 30 fps occupy 3.6666666667 seconds, 0.0066668196 seconds longer than the exact narration interval. This is the existing per-shot Math.round allocation, not a change to narration timing.

pricing.billingNote: Official documentation states per-second pricing and billing for successful generations. It does not document a provider-enforced maximum charge for this request. Actual billable duration and charge must be read from the provider result/ledger; stop if available charge information exceeds the separately approved exposure.
pricing.combinedExposureBasis: Proposed $0.25 animation exposure plus the previously human-accepted $0.05 still exposure; neither amount is a provider-enforced cap. Actual still charge remains the durable Pilot-02 ledger value.
